text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that didn't feel bad at all. If I
keep this up,
the Kikuka Sho will
surely...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Oh, no! My apologies. I lost my
concentration for
a moment.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I shall pull myself together and go for
another
lap!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: (I say that, but...)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
That makes one lap around the school
exterior. I
need to finish things up—oh?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Ah, McQueen.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
You're working really hard for the
Kikuka Sho.
That's great.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It's the Classic I've had my sights
set on
the most.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I see. So, you have strong feelings about
the race
too.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: "Too?" You must mean—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Ryan seems to be giving it her all
as well.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I just spotted her on the track a bit ago.
She was
training really hard.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Is Ryan still on the training track now?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I only just saw her, so I think she's
still
there.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Oh... McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
No, this kind of finish isn't going to cut
it! I'll get
pushed aside in the final
stretch!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I have to gain enough explosive power
to make
sure I break ahead at the end.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
That's what all this training is for! I need
it to win
in the Classics!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: She certainly has incredible drive.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
(The strength and talent required to
dominate the
Classic races...)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
(And above all else, her tremendous
efforts...)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
(Her passion regarding the final Classic
race, the
Kikuka Sho, is to be
expected...)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: And I'm no different.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Gasp! I-I'm sorry!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: ...I can't be doing this.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Could I speak with you about something
for a
moment?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
She explains to me the source of her
uneasiness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm very sorry. A personal matter has
been
distracting me from my training.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: ...Yes, if I'm being honest.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
But I don't want to lose in a
long-distance race,
either!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Therefore, in the Kikuka Sho, I...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Good, good! I'm happy you feel that
way.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Wha... Ryan?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Sorry to eavesdrop on your conversation.
I heard
my name, so I got curious.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Besides, what you said is true.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I've reached perfect form now.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
So now I can compete for real, no matter
who my
opponent is!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
(...That's right. I've perfected my form no
less
than her. And I'm no less determined
either.)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Ryan.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Your words just now have reminded me
of
something.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
All the hard work I've put forth and all
the
hardships I've endured up to this
point...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to them, our competition in the
Kikuka
Sho will be in earnest!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's a promise!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
With the Kikuka Sho as their
battleground, the
contest between the
two Mejiro family members
begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
...I won't let you take the lead
unchallenged like I
used to.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'll show you that I'm capable of running
right
alongside you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
